hypothesis: Coding exact completed WRT events through a literal/control/token hierarchy can cut arithmetic decisions and substrate invocations by at least 50 percent while retaining a bounded archive penalty small enough for selective event state and PHASECODE successors to recover.
interfaces_exposed: exact emission-group hierarchy and event probability API
kill_condition: Retire V0 hierarchy if decision reduction is below 35 percent or opening-1M archive penalty exceeds 15000 bytes before KESTREL state is added.
promotion_condition: Exact WRT and raw roundtrip plus deterministic replay; at least 50 percent fewer arithmetic decisions than bitwise WRT coding; opening-1M archive penalty no more than 5000 bytes; event and literal escape accounting complete.
title: VULCAN V0 hierarchical WRT event-rate control
